nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: So the old dungeons are open again... I have unsealed the door for you. Whatever drove those rats to the surface, the answer lies below. Be careful down there.

actions.value: The dungeon door beneath the cellar is now open.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: A sealed stone door with old markings, you say? That must be the entrance to the dungeons beneath the village.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: Long before this village was built, there were tunnels below. They were sealed generations ago when something foul moved in. If the rats came up from there, the seal must be broken.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: I know the old unsealing rite. Give me a moment... there. The door should yield to you now. But heed my warning -- whatever broke that seal is still down there.

actions.value: The Sage performs an ancient rite. The dungeon door is unsealed.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: Have you found anything in the cellar? Look carefully -- the rats must have come from somewhere deeper.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: I am glad the amulet is safe, but something still troubles me. Those rats -- they did not just wander in. Something drove them up from below.

choices.text: You want me to go back down there?
I am sure it was nothing.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: I would not ask if I were not worried. Go back to the cellar and look for whatever drove the rats to the surface. There may be a passage we never knew about.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: Thank you. The guard will let you through again. Look for anything unusual -- a crack in the wall, a hidden passage, anything.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: I understand. But if you change your mind, I will be here. I cannot shake this feeling that something worse is coming.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: You found it! I can feel its power from here.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: Thank you! Let me mend your wounds as thanks.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: Please hurry! The rats grow bolder by the hour. The cellar is through the gap to the east.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: Dark times, traveler. Rats stole my amulet of protection and dragged it into the old cellar to the east.

choices.text: I'll get it back for you.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: Bless you! Speak with the guard by the cellar entrance -- he will let you through. Clear those rats and bring back my amulet.

nodes.speaker: Village Sage
nodes.text: I understand. But without the amulet, the village is defenseless...
